reports.title: Edison International Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

lines: Based on strong year-to-date performance and our outlook for the remainder of the year, we are reaffirming our 2026 core EPS guidance range of $5.90 to $6.20.
As a result, we are reaffirming our 2026 core EPS guidance range of $5.90 to $6.20, with a bias toward the middle of the range.
We are also reaffirming our 2027 and 2028 core EPS guidance ranges and our long-term core EPS growth target of 5% to 7% through 2030.
For instance, we estimate the currently elevated credit spreads could cost customers an incremental $300 million over the life of the bonds we expect SCE will issue in 2027 alone.
From a balance sheet standpoint, we have no common equity issuance forecast through 2030, and we continue to target a long-term FFO-to-debt ratio of 15% to 17%.
